message: Thanks!  I passed this around to some librarian friends, including LIS professors and doctoral students.  ALA's mid-winter meeting is this week (thus, many people aren't around), but so far I've heard back from one professor who teaches online reference who might use it in her online reference services course.  (For the record, I have an MLS but I'm not a librarian - I'm a PhD candidate in comp-rhet)
